title: ConnectionConfig
description: Integration endpoints the engine's outbound adapters talk to — the WSO2/API6 middleware routes (external URLs, owner decision 2026-11-24: maintained in the admin UI, since they are not BTP-managed) and the C4C OData service path + field map. One global, versioned, effective-dated document (name 'GLOBAL'), same audit pattern as every other config table. DELIBERATELY excluded: credentials of any kind (API keys, users, passwords) — those stay in BTP destinations / environment secrets, never in a config document.

mode.description: recorded = replay dev fixtures, no outbound calls; live = real HTTP against baseUrl.

baseUrl.description: WSO2/API6 base URL, e.g. https://wso2.tss.example — required when mode is live.

costSourceEndpoints.description: Cost source system -> endpoint path (e.g. CCD -> /costs/ccd). The ORDER they are called in stays pricing config (region-config.costAccessSequence).

url.description: C4C tenant base URL, e.g. https://myNNNNNN.crm.ondemand.com. A URL is tenant fact, not a secret; the technical user's credentials still come from the BTP destination or environment only.

servicePath.description: OData service path on the C4C tenant, e.g. /sap/c4c/odata/v1/c4codataapi.

fieldMap.description: Our field name -> C4C field/collection name overrides (flat string entries only; the nested collections map stays code-default or C4C_FIELD_MAP env).
